verdict.rationale: Programmatic code retrieval through a CLI or API is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence documents only mobile app UI features plus open-source generator implementations and a PAM module. The PAM module handles server-side verification, not code fetching. User-side workarounds, such as reading the sqlite database on a rooted phone or saving otpauth secrets, earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
